user.title: Commax Wallpad (MITM router)
user.description: Connect via SSH to the OpenWrt router running the pure-bridge query helpers. wallpad-l2-mitm.sh must be active on the router.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the router over SSH

fast_poll.name: Refresh elevator once (legacy alias)
fast_poll.description: Compatibility alias for refresh_elevator. Reads once; never starts fast polling.

refresh_elevator.name: Refresh elevator status
refresh_elevator.description: Read elevator status, direction and floor once. Does not enable polling.

refresh_meter.name: Refresh meter readings
refresh_meter.description: Read the gas, water and electricity meter totals once now. The 30-minute schedule is unchanged.

init.title: Wallpad unlock settings
init.description: The CDP-1020MB layout supports lobby and unit entrance calls. For other wallpads, enter the exact markers from the lobby call screen. Leave all fields blank to disable the button.

data_description.intercom_screen: Exact resource ID, text or content description. Leave blank when using the CDP-1020MB screen layout.
data_description.intercom_unlock: Exact resource ID, button text or content description. Enter CDP-1020MB to use the verified screen layout.

error.invalid_intercom_profile: Check the package and screen and button markers. CDP-1020MB uses com.commax.sipua and a blank screen marker.
